item.title: Germany news: Many sites back online after PHP security fix
item.description: Online security officials have warned that it will take time to ascertain extent of any possible hacks. Meanwhile, far-right martial arts clubs are on the rise. DW has more.

item.title: Harry Kane: Ballon d’Or for Bayern Munich striker?
item.description: The most prestigious individual prize in football will be awarded on Monday, with Bayern Munich's English striker Harry Kane the front runner. Kane has developed even more in the Bundesliga despite an uneven league.
item.dc:subject: Sports

item.title: Bulgaria: Concerns about security in the Black Sea dominate presidential election campaign
item.description: Bulgaria's presidential election campaign has been shaped by recent drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea and the government's lack of support for Ukraine, making foreign policy a key factor in the first round.
